Describe the Bug

Self-hosted Send files cannot be downloaded.

Steps To Reproduce

  1. Create a new send to share a file.

  2. Open link to the file.

  3. Click download.

  4. The button will change to a spinning icon but nothing happens.

Expected Result

File should download.

Actual Result

File does not download.

Screenshots or Videos

N/A

Environment

  • Operating system: Ubuntu 18.04.5 LTS

  • Build Version: 1.41.3

  • Self Hosted: true

  • Environment: Cloud

  • Hardware: Hosted VPS

Additional Context

Doing some digging through various logs led to nothing. After browsing the bwdata directory I stumbled upon something that may or may not have anything to do with the problem. In ~/bwdata/core I see two directories. One is named attachments while the other is named attchments. The file I uploaded is stored within attchments while the attachments directory is empty. In ~/bwdata/nginx/default.conf the location there points to attachments. I see that in server/src/Core/Settings/GlobalSettings.cs on lines 13 and 14 it mentions attchments. I don't know if this is intentional, by design, or a typo.
